domain: Queen capability surface and pre-mortem supervision
summary: Skills became a managed resource with their own tab, cost became money, worker traces nest under the Queen's, and an observer reads a bee while it is still running.

defects_found.title: The Queen could reach 4 of 26 skills
defects_found.cause: knownSkills was a hardcoded Set in QueenStatusViewModel; a SKILL.md did nothing until someone edited Swift.
defects_found.fix: SkillCatalog reads .claude/skills, .trinity/skills and ~/.claude/skills; the parser hands any unrecognised slash command to SkillStore, which refuses it if no such skill exists.
defects_found.lesson: A registry that must be edited in code to grow is not a registry. The parser cannot know what exists at runtime, so it should pass the name on rather than gatekeep from a literal.

defects_found.title: No way to see or limit what she can run
defects_found.fix: SkillsTabView at Cmd+4: per-skill toggle, search, source filter, run with output, reveal in Finder. Disabled state persists to .trinity/state/queen_skills.json and is enforced for the Queen too.

defects_found.title: Cost only in tokens
defects_found.fix: ModelPricing longest-prefix table, estimatedCostUSD on the task, SwarmBudget daily ceiling that declines to START new work rather than killing running work.
defects_found.lesson: An unpriced model must report nil, not an average. Inventing a figure is how a cheap run gets cancelled as expensive.

defects_found.title: Flat traces
defects_found.fix: Stable traceId per issue and spanId per worker conversation, hashed from ids already in the record so nothing extra has to stay in sync.

defects_found.title: Supervision was entirely post-mortem
defects_found.fix: QueenObserver evaluates the live transcript for looping, spinning, out-of-bounds writes and overspending; each concern is announced once per task.
defects_found.lesson: Written as a pure function over the transcript, not a second agent: these patterns are mechanical, and a mechanical check cannot hallucinate the way the thing it watches can.

defects_found.title: Skill descriptions were garbage for files without frontmatter
defects_found.cause: The fallback took the first non-heading line, which for two skills was a bullet from the middle of a list.
defects_found.fix: Prefer the document's own H1 - the author's summary - over whatever happened to be at the top.

verification.visual: Skills tab lists 26 skills with descriptions and source badges; toggling /ascii-lint off moved the counter to 25 of 26, dimmed the row, and persisted to disk; /skills in the Queen chat listed all 26 with the disabled one marked off
verification.banner: spend now reads '1 tool' rather than '0 tokens, 1 tools'

not_done: No commit: the working tree still carries unrelated in-flight work from earlier sessions.
The observer's concerns were not triggered on a live worker - no bee looped or went out of bounds during verification.
The OTLP exporter and its nested trace ids were not exercised against a live collector.
Skill arguments and per-skill timeouts are not editable in the tab.
